title: A multicenter explainable machine learning analysis of autoimmune disease comorbidity in ankylosing spondylitis.
summary: Methods 2.1: multicenter retrospective cross-sectional cohorts from three tertiary centers (2012–2025); two classification tasks, LightGBM and SHAP. Results: stable model performance and feature differences; systemic inflammatory/metabolic phenotype is an association, not prospective early detection. Learned LightGBM classification and SHAP produce clinical comorbidity classification and feature attribution; retrospective claims only.
